children: Sonic's independent third-party audit of the S token supply concludes by 13 Oct 2026, with the findings set for publication alongside an open discussion of next steps. The review examines the integrity of S's supply and reporting, giving holders a documented basis for verification.

Publication of the audit results allows investors to verify or challenge the reported supply directly rather than relying on internal figures. Because the conclusions will be public, they can move sentiment in either direction depending on what the audit confirms or uncovers. The open discussion of next steps indicates the team intends to respond to findings rather than treat the report as a closed exercise.

For a token whose value depends on confidence in its issuance and reserves, an externally verified supply figure reduces uncertainty around a claim that is otherwise difficult to check. The audit covers supply and reporting only, not broader protocol security.

title: Sonic: Supply Audit Report Concludes with Published Findings - By 13 Oct 2026
